summary: Identified a row swap between characters 'e' and 'n' in the output classifier O_18 (evidenced by low parent-to-child cosine 0.356/0.361, inverted norms 7.64->8.33 and 7.96->7.57, and 1,364 e->n plus 837 n->e confusions at C0). Wrote runs/planted-xv/g1/s12/a/preregistration_hypotheses.md and runs/planted-xv/g1/s12/a/program.py to swap the 'e' and 'n' rows back in O_18.lin.weight and O_18.lin.bias (H1), test whether O_18.lin.bias was included in the planted swap (H2), or fall back to transplanting parent rows if H1 fails.
